info.title: PCa mHealth API
info.description: REST API of the AI-driven prostate cancer mHealth research prototype (ZCAS University). Research prototype: no AI output is a clinical diagnosis. Errors use the envelope { "error": { status, code, message, details?, requestId } }.

seq.description: Position in the chain (as text: it can exceed 2^53)

details.description: Never holds passwords, tokens or direct patient identifiers

intact.description: True when every entry links to the one before and matches its hash

activePhoneUsers.description: Accounts active from the phone app

accessDenied.description: Requests refused for lack of permission

conflicts.description: Edits that met a newer version (not overwritten)

rejected.description: Changes the server refused as invalid

byClient.description: Recorded actions by app: mobile, web, other

recentPhone.description: Latest actions from the phone app (newest first)

password.description: At least 12 characters; a passphrase is recommended

refreshToken.description: Required unless a web client sends the refresh cookie

temporaryPassword.description: Shown once. The user must change it at first sign-in.
Shown once. The user must change it at first sign-in.

mrn.description: Facility medical record number; generated when omitted

nationalIdMasked.description: Masked; only the last characters are shown

clientUuid.description: Device-generated id when the patient was registered offline

version.description: Version the client last saw (optimistic concurrency)

accountUserId.description: Link the patient's own app account (a PATIENT user)

freeToTotalPsaRatio.description: free/total PSA ratio, when both are known

psaDensity.description: PSA density (ng/mL per mL), when volume is known

freePsaNgMl.description: Free PSA in ng/mL; must not exceed total PSA

piradsScore.description: PI-RADS v2.1 category, when imaging exists

clientUuid.description: Client-generated id; resubmitting the same id returns the existing record

consentTextVersion.description: Version of the consent text the patient agreed to

updated.description: How many notifications changed to read

customised.description: True when an administrator changed the defaults

notAllowed.description: Permissions that can never be given to this role

required.description: Permissions this role must always keep

linkedToAnotherAccount.description: True when the record is already linked to another account

idempotencyKey.description: Generated once on the device; retries reuse it

entityId.description: UPDATE: server id or the clientUuid the device created it with

patientId.description: clinical_record: the patient, by server id or by the clientUuid of a patient created offline

baseVersion.description: UPDATE: the version the device edited

payload.description: Body of the matching REST call (CreatePatientDto, UpdatePatientDto without version, CreateClinicalRecordDto); validated per operation

deviceId.description: Stable id of this app installation

details.description: Field-level messages, as in VALIDATION_FAILED responses

replayed.description: True when this key was already processed and the stored result is returned

server.description: CONFLICT: the current server copy, for the user to compare

cursor.description: Pass back to get the next changes

clientUuid.description: Client-generated id; a retry with the same id never duplicates

file.description: DICOM for MRI and CT; DICOM, JPEG or PNG for TRUS. Send the other fields first.

status.description: Only files that passed every check are recorded

aiReady.description: True when a de-identified copy exists, so the file can be used in an AI analysis

aiExcludedReason.description: Why the file is not sent to the AI, in plain words

file.description: Whole-slide image (TIFF-based: SVS, TIFF, NDPI). Send the other fields first.

isupGradeGroup.description: ISUP grade group 1-5, computed by the server from the Gleason patterns

id.description: Stored artifact id (Phase 12), when one exists

available.description: False when no explanation could be produced

hasImage.description: True when an image can be fetched from GET /explanations/{id}/content

values.description: SHAP contributions, only from a real model

isMock.description: True for development mock output: show the disclaimer prominently

disclaimer.example: DEVELOPMENT MOCK DATA — NOT A CLINICAL RESULT.

inputNotes.description: Files that were not sent to the AI and why (for example, no de-identified copy)

patientMrn.description: Facility record number; only on the facility-wide list

error.description: Why it failed, in plain words

report.description: Present on the single-job endpoint once the job succeeded

evaluationAvailable.description: True only when a stored evaluation run exists

available.description: True only when a stored evaluation run exists

evaluation.description: The stored evaluation (metrics, including per-group fairness figures)

aiReportsLeftOutMock.description: Development mock AI results found for these patients; they are never exported

patientsWithConsent.description: Patients with the consent this purpose needs

maxPatients.description: Largest number of patients in one export

smartcareConfigured.description: Whether a SmartCare Pro address is set

smartcareHost.description: SmartCare Pro host name (never the token)

purpose.description: RESEARCH includes patients with research-use consent; NATIONAL_EHR (SmartCare Pro) includes patients with EHR-sharing consent.
